note: Recorded requirements for module REG (hand-authored, see README).

requirements.title: Applicant registration with mobile OTP
requirements.description: The system shall register an applicant with a mobile number verified by a 6-digit OTP valid for 10 minutes, and allow one active registration per mobile number.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new mobile number, when the correct OTP is entered within 10 minutes, then the applicant account is created.
Given a mobile number already registered, when registration is attempted, then the system refuses it and offers sign-in.

requirements.title: Aadhaar e-KYC of the applicant
requirements.description: The system shall perform Aadhaar OTP e-KYC of every applicant through the State AUA/KUA before an application can be submitted, prefill name, date of birth and gender from the e-KYC response as read-only fields, and store the Aadhaar number only in the Aadhaar Data Vault.
acceptanceCriteria: Given consent is recorded and a valid Aadhaar number is entered, when the e-KYC OTP is verified, then name, date of birth and gender are prefilled and cannot be edited.
Given e-KYC fails three times, when the applicant retries, then the system directs the applicant to a CSC for biometric e-KYC.

requirements.title: Officer sign-in with jurisdiction
requirements.description: The system shall authenticate institution nodal officers and District Social Welfare Officers through Jan Parichay with two-factor authentication and show each officer only the applications of their institution or district.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a nodal officer mapped to one institution, when they sign in, then only applications of that institution are listed.
